question: Swali
defaultDirections: Chagua jibu unalohisi linajibu swali. Ukimaliza, bonyeza {checkAnswer}. Utapata maoni yanayoonyesha usahihi wa jibu lako na jinsi ya kuendelea.

evidenceDescription: Hii huonyeshwa ikiwa mtumiaji atapata jibu sahihi
